text: Grandson's 3 months, temp 38.1 this evening. Bit of a long night. He was sick once after his feed earlier but he's kept his bottle down since, no more of that. In between the paracetamol he's actually alright, playing with his feet, drinking fine, making his little noises at me. No rash anywhere, I've had him undressed and checked all over. Daughter's asleep, she's been up two nights running, so I said I'd ask. Is it just a case of carrying on as we are
